name: au-melanoma-checkpoint-gide
title: Metastatic melanoma on immune checkpoint blockade
description: Patients with stage IV melanoma treated with anti-PD-1 alone (pembrolizumab or nivolumab) or combined with ipilimumab, at Melanoma Institute Australia and other centres: 75 patients with treatment, best response, tumour neoantigen counts and overall survival.

sources.title: Melanoma Institute Australia and The University of Sydney, Gide TN et al. (2019). Distinct immune cell populations define response to anti-PD-1 monotherapy and anti-PD-1/anti-CTLA-4 combined therapy. Cancer Cell 35(2): 238-255
